Step 6: Multi-Row 8×8 Square Warps, Per-Warp Rings & Pipe-Balanced Math  ·  +148 / −121 lines across 4 changed files

  • (a) 2-pixel/thread 8×8 square warps & per-warp __syncwarp() staging slices (csrc/forward.cu.cc, csrc/backward.cu.cc, csrc/rasterizer_impl.h): Switches to kDefaultForwardRows = 2, kDefaultBackwardRows = 2 (4 warps of 128 threads per 16×16 tile, each warp covering a square 8×8 sub-tile) and decouples the 4 warps in RasterBackwardKernel into independent 32-splat shared-memory slices (warp_base = warp * 32) synchronized with __syncwarp() and zero __syncthreads(); its occupancy target goes from __launch_bounds__(..., 4) to 6 blocks of 128 threads.
  • (b) Folded log2(opacity), zero-multiply row moments & sign-bit transmittance termination (csrc/auxiliary.h, csrc/forward.cu.cc, csrc/backward.cu.cc): Folds log2f(opacity) into Power2Column::At (eliminating the per-pixel opacity multiply before MUFU.EX2), evaluates 2-row vertical moments with zero multiplies (m1 = ga[1], m2 = ga[1]), and encodes pixel termination in the sign bit of t[k].

302// Reduce-scatter of an array of `N` <= 32 per-lane values over the warp.302// Reduce-scatter of an array of `N` <= 32 per-lane values over the warp.
303//303//
304// A butterfly where each step halves the payload: at offset `o`, lanes with304// A butterfly where each step halves the payload: at offset `o`, lanes with
305// bit `o` clear keep the low half of the array and send the high half, the305// bit `o` clear keep the low half of the array and send the high half, the
306// others do the opposite. After log2(32) steps every lane holds a single306// others do the opposite. After log2(32) steps every lane holds a single
307// value, v[0], which is the warp total of element `ScatterIndex(N, lane)`307// value, v[0], which is the warp total of element `ScatterIndex(N, lane)`
308// (or junk if that is -1). For N = 9 this takes 12 shuffles instead of the308// (or junk if that is -1). For N = 9 this takes 12 shuffles instead of the
309// 45 of nine independent butterflies, and the totals end in distinct lanes,309// 45 of nine independent butterflies, and the totals end in distinct lanes,
310// so writing them out is one instruction.310// so writing them out is one instruction.

313template <int N, int kOffset>313template <int N, int kOffset>
314GS_D void HalvingStep(float* v, int lane) {314GS_D void HalvingStep(float* v, int lane) {
315 constexpr int kHalf = (N + 1) / 2;315 constexpr int kHalf = (N + 1) / 2;
316 const bool upper = lane & kOffset;316 const bool upper = lane & kOffset;
317#pragma unroll317#pragma unroll
318 for (int i = 0; i < kHalf; ++i) {318 for (int i = 0; i < kHalf; ++i) {
319 const float lo = v[i];319 const float lo = v[i];
320 const float hi = i + kHalf < N ? v[i + kHalf] : 0.0f;320 const float hi = i + kHalf < N ? v[i + kHalf] : 0.0f;
321 const float send = upper ? lo : hi;321 const float send = upper ? lo : hi;
322 const float keep = upper ? hi : lo;322 const float keep = upper ? hi : lo;
323 v[i] = keep + __shfl_xor_sync(kFullMask, send, kOffset);323 v[i] = keep + __shfl_xor_sync(kFullMask, send, kOffset);
324 }324 }
325}325}

330 HalvingStep<N, kOffset>(v, lane);330 HalvingStep<N, kOffset>(v, lane);
331 ReduceScatterImpl<(N + 1) / 2, kOffset / 2>(v, lane);331 ReduceScatterImpl<(N + 1) / 2, kOffset / 2>(v, lane);
332 }332 }

348// Element whose warp total lane `lane` holds after `ReduceScatter<N>`, or -1.348// Element whose warp total lane `lane` holds after `ReduceScatter<N>`, or -1.
349GS_HD constexpr int ScatterIndex(int n, int lane) {349GS_HD constexpr int ScatterIndex(int n, int lane) {
350 // Payload sizes and halves per step, offset 16 first.350 // Payload sizes and halves per step, offset 16 first.
351 int sizes[5] = {};351 int sizes[5] = {};
352 int size = n;352 int size = n;
353 for (int s = 0; s < 5; ++s) {353 for (int s = 0; s < 5; ++s) {
354 sizes[s] = size;354 sizes[s] = size;
355 size = (size + 1) / 2;355 size = (size + 1) / 2;
356 }356 }
357 int index = 0; // Slot in the final (size 1) array.357 int index = 0; // Slot in the final (size 1) array.
358 for (int s = 4; s >= 0; --s) {358 for (int s = 4; s >= 0; --s) {
359 const int half = (sizes[s] + 1) / 2;359 const int half = (sizes[s] + 1) / 2;
360 if (lane & (16 >> s)) index += half;360 if (lane & (16 >> s)) index += half;
361 if (index >= sizes[s]) return -1;361 if (index >= sizes[s]) return -1;
362 }362 }
363 return index;363 return index;
364}364}

172172 // Tile rectangle of a splat of integer bounding `radius`, identical to the

174174 GS_HD TileRect RectFor(float2 xy, int radius, const TileGrid& grid) {
175175 const float r = static_cast<float>(radius);

195195 // alpha = o exp(-q/2) >= 1/255 <=> q <= 2 ln(255 o). Writes the bound on q
196196 // with margins that keep tests conservative under float rounding of the
197197 // rasterizer's power. Returns false if no pixel can reach 1/255.
198198 GS_HD bool AlphaLimit(float opacity, float& limit) {
199199 const float o255 = opacity * 255.0f;
200200 if (!(o255 >= 0.999f)) return false;
201201 limit = 2.0f * logf(fmaxf(o255, 1.0f)) * 1.001f + 0.02f;

208208 // Precomputed splat-level ellipse constants for fast band intersection tests

211211 float a, b, c;
212212 float det;
213213 float inv_a;
214214 float a_limit;
215215 float y_ext;
216216 float dy_peak;

218218 GS_D static bool Init(float3 conic, float opacity, float cached_limit,
219219 EllipseBounds& out) {
220220 float limit = cached_limit;
221221 if (limit <= 0.0f && !AlphaLimit(opacity, limit)) return false;
222222 out.a = conic.x;
223223 out.b = conic.y;
224224 out.c = conic.z;
225225 out.det = out.a * out.c - out.b * out.b;
226226 if (!(out.det > 0.0f && out.a > 0.0f && out.c > 0.0f)) return false;
227227 out.inv_a = 1.0f / out.a;
228228 out.a_limit = out.a * limit;
229229 const float limit_over_det = limit / out.det;
230230 out.y_ext = sqrtf(out.a * limit_over_det);
231231 out.dy_peak = out.b * sqrtf(limit_over_det / out.c);
232232 return true;
233233 }

235235 // Span [x0_px, x1_px] of integer pixel columns hit across integer pixel rows
236236 // Y in [y0_px, y1_px] (inclusive). Returns false if no integer pixel hits.
237237 GS_D bool SpanForPixelRows(float2 xy, int y0_px, int y1_px, int& x0_px,
238238 int& x1_px) const {
239239 const int ylo_i =
240240 max(y0_px, static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.y - y_ext - kSpanPadPx)));
241241 const int yhi_i =
242242 min(y1_px, static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.y + y_ext + kSpanPadPx)));
243243 if (ylo_i > yhi_i) return false;
244244 const float ylo = static_cast<float>(ylo_i) - xy.y;
245245 const float yhi = static_cast<float>(yhi_i) - xy.y;
246246 // Boundary x(dy) = (-b dy +- sqrt(a limit - det dy^2)) / a; the right
247247 // (left) branch is concave (convex) and peaks at dy = -+dy_peak.
248248 const float dyr = fminf(yhi, fmaxf(ylo, -dy_peak));
249249 const float dyl = fminf(yhi, fmaxf(ylo, dy_peak));
250250 const float dyr2 = dyr * dyr, dyl2 = dyl * dyl;
251251 const float rr = sqrtf(fmaxf(0.0f, a_limit - det * dyr2));
252252 const float rl =
253253 (dyr2 == dyl2) ? rr : sqrtf(fmaxf(0.0f, a_limit - det * dyl2));
254254 const float hi = (-b * dyr + rr) * inv_a;
255255 const float lo = (-b * dyl - rl) * inv_a;
256256 x0_px = static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.x + lo - kSpanPadPx));
257257 x1_px = static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.x + hi + kSpanPadPx));
258258 return x0_px <= x1_px;
259259 }
260260 };

262262 // Visits every tile row `ty` with the half-open span [tx0, tx1) of tiles that
263263 // splat `s` (not culled) is binned to. Rows may be empty (tx0 >= tx1).
264264 template <Culling kCulling, typename Fn>
265265 GS_D void ForEachTileRow(const Splat& s, const TileGrid& grid, int width,
266266 int height, Fn&& fn) {
267267 const float2 xy = s.xy();

269269 if constexpr (kCulling == Culling::kRect) {
270270 for (int ty = rect.y0; ty < rect.y1; ++ty) fn(ty, rect.x0, rect.x1);
271271 } else {
272272 EllipseBounds eb;
273273 if (!EllipseBounds::Init(s.conic(), s.opacity(), s.limit(), eb)) return;
274274 const int min_y =
275275 max(0, static_cast<int>(ceilf(xy.y - eb.y_ext - kSpanPadPx)));
276276 const int max_y =
277277 min(height - 1, static_cast<int>(floorf(xy.y + eb.y_ext + kSpanPadPx)));
278278 if (min_y > max_y) return;

280280 const int ty1 = min(rect.y1, (max_y / kTileSize) + 1);

283283 if (!eb.SpanForPixelRows(xy, ty * kTileSize,
284284 min((ty + 1) * kTileSize, height) - 1, x0_px,
285285 x1_px)) {
286286 continue;
287287 }
288288 x0_px = max(0, x0_px);
289289 x1_px = min(width - 1, x1_px);
290290 if (x0_px > x1_px) continue;
291291 const int tx0 = max(rect.x0, x0_px / kTileSize);

300300 inline constexpr unsigned kFullMask = 0xffffffffu;
301301
302302 // Reduce-scatter of an array of `N` <= 32 per-lane values over the warp.
303303 //
304304 // A butterfly where each step halves the payload: at offset `o`, lanes with
305305 // bit `o` clear keep the low half of the array and send the high half, the
306306 // others do the opposite. After log2(32) steps every lane holds a single
307307 // value, v[0], which is the warp total of element `ScatterIndex(N, lane)`
308308 // (or junk if that is -1). For N = 9 this takes 12 shuffles instead of the
309309 // 45 of nine independent butterflies, and the totals end in distinct lanes,
310310 // so writing them out is one instruction.
311311
312312 namespace internal {
313313 template <int N, int kOffset>
314314 GS_D void HalvingStep(float* v, int lane) {
315315 constexpr int kHalf = (N + 1) / 2;
316316 const bool upper = lane & kOffset;
317317 #pragma unroll
318318 for (int i = 0; i < kHalf; ++i) {
319319 const float lo = v[i];
320320 const float hi = i + kHalf < N ? v[i + kHalf] : 0.0f;
321321 const float send = upper ? lo : hi;
322322 const float keep = upper ? hi : lo;
323323 v[i] = keep + __shfl_xor_sync(kFullMask, send, kOffset);
324324 }
325325 }
326326
327327 template <int N, int kOffset>
328328 GS_D void ReduceScatterImpl(float* v, int lane) {
329329 if constexpr (kOffset > 0) {
330330 HalvingStep<N, kOffset>(v, lane);
331331 ReduceScatterImpl<(N + 1) / 2, kOffset / 2>(v, lane);
332332 }
333333 }
334334 } // namespace internal
335335
336336 template <int N>
337337 GS_D void ReduceScatter(float (&v)[N], int lane) {
338338 static_assert(N >= 1 && N <= 32);
339339 internal::ReduceScatterImpl<N, 16>(v, lane);
340340 }
341341
342342 template <int N>
343343 GS_D void ReduceScatter16(float (&v)[N], int lane) {
344344 static_assert(N >= 1 && N <= 16);
345345 internal::ReduceScatterImpl<N, 8>(v, lane);
346346 }

348348 // Element whose warp total lane `lane` holds after `ReduceScatter<N>`, or -1.
349349 GS_HD constexpr int ScatterIndex(int n, int lane) {
350350 // Payload sizes and halves per step, offset 16 first.
351351 int sizes[5] = {};
352352 int size = n;
353353 for (int s = 0; s < 5; ++s) {
354354 sizes[s] = size;
355355 size = (size + 1) / 2;
356356 }
357357 int index = 0; // Slot in the final (size 1) array.
358358 for (int s = 4; s >= 0; --s) {
359359 const int half = (sizes[s] + 1) / 2;
360360 if (lane & (16 >> s)) index += half;
361361 if (index >= sizes[s]) return -1;
362362 }
363363 return index;
364364 }

366366 // Element whose 16-lane half-warp total lane `lane` holds after
367367 // `ReduceScatter16<N>`, or -1.
368368 GS_HD constexpr int ScatterIndex16(int n, int lane) {
369369 const int half_lane = lane & 15;
370370 int sizes[4] = {};
371371 int size = n;
372372 for (int s = 0; s < 4; ++s) {
373373 sizes[s] = size;
374374 size = (size + 1) / 2;
375375 }
376376 int index = 0;
377377 for (int s = 3; s >= 0; --s) {
378378 const int half = (sizes[s] + 1) / 2;
379379 if (half_lane & (8 >> s)) index += half;
380380 if (index >= sizes[s]) return -1;
381381 }
382382 return index;
383383 }

437437 const float4* p = reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(row) + 3 * grp;

440440 v[4] = b.x, v[5] = b.y, v[6] = b.z, v[7] = b.w;
441441 v[8] = c.x, v[9] = c.y, v[10] = c.z, v[11] = c.w;

443443 GS_D static void StoreGroup(float* row, int grp, const float v[12]) {
444444 float4* p = reinterpret_cast<float4*>(row) + 3 * grp;
445445 p[0] = {v[0], v[1], v[2], v[3]};
446446 p[1] = {v[4], v[5], v[6], v[7]};
447447 p[2] = {v[8], v[9], v[10], v[11]};

506506 // Basis values for a unit direction.
507507 GS_D void Basis(float3 d, float b[kShCoeffs]) {
508508 const float x = d.x, y = d.y, z = d.z;
509509 const float xx = x * x, yy = y * y, zz = z * z;
510510 b[0] = kC0;
511511 b[1] = -kC1 * y;
512512 b[2] = kC1 * z;
513513 b[3] = -kC1 * x;
514514 b[4] = kC2[0] * x * y;
515515 b[5] = kC2[1] * y * z;
516516 b[6] = kC2[2] * (2.0f * zz - xx - yy);
517517 b[7] = kC2[3] * x * z;
518518 b[8] = kC2[4] * (xx - yy);
519519 b[9] = kC3[0] * y * (3.0f * xx - yy);
520520 b[10] = kC3[1] * x * y * z;
521521 b[11] = kC3[2] * y * (4.0f * zz - xx - yy);
522522 b[12] = kC3[3] * z * (2.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - 3.0f * yy);
523523 b[13] = kC3[4] * x * (4.0f * zz - xx - yy);
524524 b[14] = kC3[5] * z * (xx - yy);
525525 b[15] = kC3[6] * x * (xx - 3.0f * yy);

528528 // Pre-clamp color 0.5 + sum_k b_k sh_k, reading directly from an SH row.
529529 template <typename ShT>
530530 GS_D float3 EvalRow(const ShT* __restrict__ sh_row, const float b[kShCoeffs]) {
531531 float3 c = {0.5f, 0.5f, 0.5f};
532532 #pragma unroll
533533 for (int grp = 0; grp < 4; ++grp) {
534534 const int k0 = 4 * grp;
535535 float v[12];
536536 ShIo<ShT>::LoadGroup(sh_row, grp, v);
537537 c += b[k0] * float3{v[0], v[1], v[2]};
538538 c += b[k0 + 1] * float3{v[3], v[4], v[5]};
539539 c += b[k0 + 2] * float3{v[6], v[7], v[8]};
540540 c += b[k0 + 3] * float3{v[9], v[10], v[11]};
541541 }
542542 return c;
543543 }

549549 // Standard rotation matrix of the (unnormalized) quaternion (w, x, y, z).
550550 GS_D Mat3 QuatToRotation(float4 q) {
551551 const float w = q.x, x = q.y, y = q.z, z = q.w;
552552 Mat3 r;
553553 r.m[0][0] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (y * y + z * z);
554554 r.m[0][1] = 2.0f * (x * y - w * z);
555555 r.m[0][2] = 2.0f * (x * z + w * y);
556556 r.m[1][0] = 2.0f * (x * y + w * z);
557557 r.m[1][1] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (x * x + z * z);
558558 r.m[1][2] = 2.0f * (y * z - w * x);
559559 r.m[2][0] = 2.0f * (x * z - w * y);
560560 r.m[2][1] = 2.0f * (y * z + w * x);
561561 r.m[2][2] = 1.0f - 2.0f * (x * x + y * y);
562562 return r;
563563 }

574574 // Sigma = A A^T with A = R diag(s).

597597 // Computes 2D covariance given view-space mean `t` (with t.z > kNearPlane).
598598 GS_D void ProjectCovarianceFromView(const Camera& cam, float3 t, float3 scale,
599599 float4 quat, ProjectionState& st) {
600600 st.t = t;
601601 const float tz = t.z;
602602 const float limx = kFovClamp * cam.TanHalfFovX();
603603 const float limy = kFovClamp * cam.TanHalfFovY();
604604 const float txtz = t.x / tz, tytz = t.y / tz;
605605 st.x_clamped = txtz < -limx || txtz > limx;
606606 st.y_clamped = tytz < -limy || tytz > limy;
607607 st.tx_c = fminf(limx, fmaxf(-limx, txtz)) * tz;
608608 st.ty_c = fminf(limy, fmaxf(-limy, tytz)) * tz;
609609 const float j00 = cam.fx / tz, j02 = -cam.fx * st.tx_c / (tz * tz);
610610 const float j11 = cam.fy / tz, j12 = -cam.fy * st.ty_c / (tz * tz);
611611 const Mat3& w = cam.rotation;
612612 st.m0 = j00 * w.row(0) + j02 * w.row(2);
613613 st.m1 = j11 * w.row(1) + j12 * w.row(2);

615615 const float3 s0 = st.sigma.Mul(st.m0), s1 = st.sigma.Mul(st.m1);
616616 st.a = dot(st.m0, s0) + kLowPass;
617617 st.b = dot(st.m0, s1);
618618 st.c = dot(st.m1, s1) + kLowPass;

1818 // Screen-space geometry of Gaussian `i`: everything in `Projection` except
1919 // `rgb`. `radius` = 0 marks a culled Gaussian (the caller also applies the
2020 // tile-rectangle cull).
2121 template <Culling kCulling>
2222 GS_D Projection ProjectGeometry(const GaussianParams& p, const Camera& cam,
2323 float3 mean, int i) {
2424 Projection out;
2525 out.radius = 0;
2626 const float3 t = cam.ToView(mean);
2727 if (t.z <= kNearPlane) return out;
2828 const float opacity = p.opacities[i];
2929 float limit = 0.0f;
3030 if (!AlphaLimit(opacity, limit)) {
3131 if constexpr (kCulling == Culling::kEllipse) return out;
3232 }
3333 const float3 scale = {p.scales[3 * i], p.scales[3 * i + 1],
3434 p.scales[3 * i + 2]};
3535 const float4 quat = reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(p.quats)[i];
3636 ProjectionState st;
3737 ProjectCovarianceFromView(cam, t, scale, quat, st);
3838 const float det = st.a * st.c - st.b * st.b;
3939 if (det == 0.0f) return out;
4040 const float inv = 1.0f / det;
4141 out.conic = {st.c * inv, -st.b * inv, st.a * inv};
4242 out.xy = ProjectMean(cam, st.t);
4343 out.depth = st.t.z;
4444 out.opacity = opacity;
4545 out.limit = limit;
4646 out.radius = BoundingRadius(st.a, st.b, st.c);
4747 return out;
4848 }

5050 // Color seen along `dir`, clamped at zero, reading from an SH row.
5151 template <typename ShT>
5252 GS_D float3 ShadeColorRow(const ShT* sh_row, float3 dir) {
5353 float basis[kShCoeffs];
5454 sh::Basis(dir, basis);
5555 const float3 raw = sh::EvalRow(sh_row, basis);
5656 return {fmaxf(raw.x, 0.0f), fmaxf(raw.y, 0.0f), fmaxf(raw.z, 0.0f)};
5757 }

1919 // Evaluates SH color VJP reading the row `sh_in` and writing dL/dsh directly
2020 // to the row `sh_out` (same storage type), group by group.
2121 template <typename ShT>
2222 GS_D float3 VjpRow(float3 d, float3 g_rgb, const ShT* __restrict__ sh_in,
2323 ShT* __restrict__ sh_out) {
2424 float b[kShCoeffs];
2525 Basis(d, b);
2626 const float3 raw = EvalRow(sh_in, b);
2727 const float3 drgb = {raw.x < 0.0f ? 0.0f : g_rgb.x,
2828 raw.y < 0.0f ? 0.0f : g_rgb.y,
2929 raw.z < 0.0f ? 0.0f : g_rgb.z};
3030 const float x = d.x, y = d.y, z = d.z;
3131 const float xx = x * x, yy = y * y, zz = z * z;
3232 const float xy = x * y, xz = x * z, yz = y * z;
3333 float3 ddir = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
3434 #pragma unroll
3535 for (int grp = 0; grp < 4; ++grp) {
3636 const int k0 = 4 * grp;
3737 float v[12];
3838 ShIo<ShT>::LoadGroup(sh_in, grp, v);
3939 const float s0 = v[0] * drgb.x + v[1] * drgb.y + v[2] * drgb.z;
4040 const float s1 = v[3] * drgb.x + v[4] * drgb.y + v[5] * drgb.z;
4141 const float s2 = v[6] * drgb.x + v[7] * drgb.y + v[8] * drgb.z;
4242 const float s3 = v[9] * drgb.x + v[10] * drgb.y + v[11] * drgb.z;
4343 float out[12];
4444 #pragma unroll
4545 for (int q = 0; q < 4; ++q) {
4646 out[3 * q] = b[k0 + q] * drgb.x;
4747 out[3 * q + 1] = b[k0 + q] * drgb.y;
4848 out[3 * q + 2] = b[k0 + q] * drgb.z;
4949 }
5050 ShIo<ShT>::StoreGroup(sh_out, grp, out);
5151 if (grp == 0) {
5252 ddir.y += s1 * (-kC1);
5353 ddir.z += s2 * kC1;
5454 ddir.x += s3 * (-kC1);
5555 } else if (grp == 1) {
5656 ddir += (s0 * kC2[0]) * float3{y, x, 0.0f};
5757 ddir += (s1 * kC2[1]) * float3{0.0f, z, y};
5858 ddir += (s2 * kC2[2]) * float3{-2.0f * x, -2.0f * y, 4.0f * z};
5959 ddir += (s3 * kC2[3]) * float3{z, 0.0f, x};
6060 } else if (grp == 2) {
6161 ddir += (s0 * kC2[4]) * float3{2.0f * x, -2.0f * y, 0.0f};
6262 ddir += (s1 * kC3[0]) * float3{6.0f * xy, 3.0f * (xx - yy), 0.0f};
6363 ddir += (s2 * kC3[1]) * float3{yz, xz, xy};
6464 ddir += (s3 * kC3[2]) *
6565 float3{-2.0f * xy, 4.0f * zz - xx - 3.0f * yy, 8.0f * yz};
6666 } else {
6767 ddir += (s0 * kC3[3]) *
6868 float3{-6.0f * xz, -6.0f * yz, 6.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - 3.0f * yy};
6969 ddir += (s1 * kC3[4]) *
7070 float3{4.0f * zz - 3.0f * xx - yy, -2.0f * xy, 8.0f * xz};
7171 ddir += (s2 * kC3[5]) * float3{2.0f * xz, -2.0f * yz, xx - yy};
7272 ddir += (s3 * kC3[6]) * float3{3.0f * (xx - yy), -6.0f * xy, 0.0f};
7373 }
7474 }
7575 return ddir;
7676 }

7979 // VJP of the projection for a touched Gaussian `i`; reads its SH row from
8080 // `sh_in` and writes dL/dsh directly to `sh_out`.
8181 // Writes non-SH parameter gradients to `dmean_out`, `dscale_out`, `dquat_out`.
8282 template <typename ShT>
8383 GS_D void ProjectVjp(const GaussianParams& p, const Camera& cam, int i,
8484 const ShT* __restrict__ sh_in, ShT* __restrict__ sh_out,
8585 const ProjectionGrad& g, float3& dmean_out,
8686 float3& dscale_out, float4& dquat_out) {
8787 const float3 mean = LoadMean(p, i);
8888 const float3 scale = {p.scales[3 * i], p.scales[3 * i + 1],
8989 p.scales[3 * i + 2]};
9090 const float4 quat = reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(p.quats)[i];
9191
9292 // --- Color: rgb = max(0.5 + sum_k B_k(dir) sh_k, 0).
9393 float3 dmean = {0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
9494 {
9595 float inv_len;
9696 const float3 dir = ViewDir(cam, mean, inv_len);
9797 const float3 ddir = sh::VjpRow(dir, g.rgb, sh_in, sh_out);
9898 // d(v/|v|)/dv = (I - dir dir^T) / |v|.
9999 dmean += inv_len * (ddir - dot(dir, ddir) * dir);
100100 }
101101
102102 // --- Forward covariance intermediates (reusing R, s0, s1 in VJP).
103103 const float3 t = cam.ToView(mean);
104104 const float tz = t.z;
105105 const float limx = kFovClamp * cam.TanHalfFovX();
106106 const float limy = kFovClamp * cam.TanHalfFovY();
107107 const float txtz = t.x / tz, tytz = t.y / tz;
108108 const bool x_clamped = txtz < -limx || txtz > limx;
109109 const bool y_clamped = tytz < -limy || tytz > limy;
110110 const float tx_c = fminf(limx, fmaxf(-limx, txtz)) * tz;
111111 const float ty_c = fminf(limy, fmaxf(-limy, tytz)) * tz;
112112 const float j00 = cam.fx / tz, j02 = -cam.fx * tx_c / (tz * tz);
113113 const float j11 = cam.fy / tz, j12 = -cam.fy * ty_c / (tz * tz);
114114 const Mat3& w = cam.rotation;
115115 const float3 m0 = j00 * w.row(0) + j02 * w.row(2);
116116 const float3 m1 = j11 * w.row(1) + j12 * w.row(2);
117117
118118 const Mat3 r = QuatToRotation(quat);
119119 const Sym3 sigma = Covariance3D(r, scale);
120120 const float3 s0 = sigma.Mul(m0), s1 = sigma.Mul(m1);
121121 const float cov_a = dot(m0, s0) + kLowPass;
122122 const float cov_b = dot(m0, s1);
123123 const float cov_c = dot(m1, s1) + kLowPass;
124124
125125 // --- Conic -> 2D covariance: G_cov = -K G_K K.
126126 const float det = cov_a * cov_c - cov_b * cov_b;
127127 const float inv = 1.0f / det;
128128 const float ka = cov_c * inv, kb = -cov_b * inv, kc = cov_a * inv;
129129 const float ga = g.conic.x, gb = 0.5f * g.conic.y, gc = g.conic.z;
130130 // P = G_K K.
131131 const float p00 = ga * ka + gb * kb, p01 = ga * kb + gb * kc;
132132 const float p10 = gb * ka + gc * kb, p11 = gb * kb + gc * kc;
133133 // G_cov = -K P (symmetric).
134134 const float ca = -(ka * p00 + kb * p10);
135135 const float cb = -(ka * p01 + kb * p11);
136136 const float cc = -(kb * p01 + kc * p11);
137137
138138 // --- cov = M Sigma M^T: dM = 2 G_cov M Sigma, dSigma = M^T G_cov M.
139139 const float3 dm0 = 2.0f * (ca * s0 + cb * s1);
140140 const float3 dm1 = 2.0f * (cb * s0 + cc * s1);
141141 // dSigma = ca m0 m0^T + cb (m0 m1^T + m1 m0^T) + cc m1 m1^T.
142142 Sym3 dsig;
143143 dsig.xx = ca * m0.x * m0.x + 2.0f * cb * m0.x * m1.x + cc * m1.x * m1.x;
144144 dsig.yy = ca * m0.y * m0.y + 2.0f * cb * m0.y * m1.y + cc * m1.y * m1.y;
145145 dsig.zz = ca * m0.z * m0.z + 2.0f * cb * m0.z * m1.z + cc * m1.z * m1.z;
146146 dsig.xy =
147147 ca * m0.x * m0.y + cb * (m0.x * m1.y + m1.x * m0.y) + cc * m1.x * m1.y;
148148 dsig.xz =
149149 ca * m0.x * m0.z + cb * (m0.x * m1.z + m1.x * m0.z) + cc * m1.x * m1.z;
150150 dsig.yz =
151151 ca * m0.y * m0.z + cb * (m0.y * m1.z + m1.y * m0.z) + cc * m1.y * m1.z;
152152
153153 // --- M = J W: dJ = dM W^T (only the nonzero entries of J).
154154 const float dj00 = dot(dm0, w.row(0)), dj02 = dot(dm0, w.row(2));
155155 const float dj11 = dot(dm1, w.row(1)), dj12 = dot(dm1, w.row(2));
156156 const float tz2 = tz * tz, tz3 = tz2 * tz;
157157 float3 dt;
158158 dt.x = x_clamped ? 0.0f : -cam.fx / tz2 * dj02;
159159 dt.y = y_clamped ? 0.0f : -cam.fy / tz2 * dj12;
160160 dt.z = -cam.fx / tz2 * dj00 - cam.fy / tz2 * dj11 +
161161 2.0f * cam.fx * tx_c / tz3 * dj02 + 2.0f * cam.fy * ty_c / tz3 * dj12;
162162 // --- Screen-space mean u = fx x / z + cx.
163163 dt.x += cam.fx / tz * g.xy.x;
164164 dt.y += cam.fy / tz * g.xy.y;
165165 dt.z -= (cam.fx * t.x * g.xy.x + cam.fy * t.y * g.xy.y) / tz2;
166166 dmean += MulT(w, dt);
167167 dmean_out = dmean;
168168
169169 // --- Sigma = A A^T, A = R diag(s): dA = 2 dSigma A.
170170 const float sv[3] = {scale.x, scale.y, scale.z};
171171 float ds[3];
172172 Mat3 dr;
173173 #pragma unroll
174174 for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
175175 const float3 r_col = r.col(j);
176176 const float3 da_col = (2.0f * sv[j]) * dsig.Mul(r_col);
177177 ds[j] = dot(da_col, r_col);
178178 dr.m[0][j] = da_col.x * sv[j];
179179 dr.m[1][j] = da_col.y * sv[j];
180180 dr.m[2][j] = da_col.z * sv[j];
181181 }
182182 dscale_out = {ds[0], ds[1], ds[2]};
183183
184184 // --- R(q) -> q.
185185 const float qw = quat.x, qx = quat.y, qy = quat.z, qz = quat.w;
